title: Error receiving too much data
body:
Hello! I'm using Huawei p30 android version 10 with the libre sensor. This set up used to work fine until recently, the calibrations were very inaccurate and if I tried to delete too many calibrations, or the calibrations that the graph line is on, the whole set-up would fail. Is this normal?? 

It happened again today to my 2 day old sensor and I've tried reinstalling the app a few times but to no avail. I keep getting the error message that says 'error receiving too much data' and it refuses to start up. Any help would be appreciated. Thank you 
![Screenshot_20201002_011825_com eveningoutpost dexdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/59817719/94842915-86c5c400-044e-11eb-8fc1-98ff367b10c7.jpg)

comments.body: Please report the xDip version and your hardware environment (which Libre sensor, any bridge like blucon, etc.).
